channel.title: The Hollywood Reporter Inc. - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter Inc. (thr.com)

item.title: ‘Euphoria’ Creator Sam Levinson Donates $27K to Eric Dane’s GoFundMe
item.description: Dane, who died at 53, less than a year after being diagnosed with ALS, filmed the HBO series' highly-anticipated third season prior to his death.

item.title: Ilker Çatak’s ‘Yellow Letters’ Wins Berlinale Golden Bear
item.description: Sandra Hüller took best acting honors for her gender-shifting role in 'Rose,' Anna Calder-Marshall and Tom Courtney won best supporting for 'Queen at Sea.'

item.title: Margot Robbie’s 11 Best Performances, Ranked
item.description: Hi, Barbie! From her breakthrough role in 'The Wolf of Wall Street' to 'Bombshell' and, of course, her standout turns as Harley Quinn, The Hollywood Reporter ranks the best performances of the actress' career.

item.title: Hilary Duff Breaks Silence on “Toxic Mom Group” Drama After Ashley Tisdale’s Essay: “This Is Not New for Me”
item.description: Last month, Tisdale published an essay detailing why she broke up with her friend group, which Duff was believed to be a part of.

item.title: Mark Ruffalo Questions James Cameron’s Disapproval of Netflix-Warner Bros. Deal, Support of Paramount
item.description: "The next question to Mr Cameron should be this… 'Are you also against the monopolization that a Paramount acquisition would create? Or is it just that of Netflix?'" the 'Task' actor wrote on Saturday.

item.title: Ex-Sony CEO Calls ‘The Interview’ His Biggest Career Mistake, Says Obama Asked Him “What Were You Thinking?” After Cyber Hack
item.description: The making of the 2014 film starring Seth Rogen and James Franco resulted in a cyberattack that leaked confidential scripts and personal information.

item.title: Trump Says Netflix Should Fire Board Member Susan Rice “Immediately, or Pay the Consequences”
item.description: His comments come after Rice said in a recent interview that those who have "take[n] a knee to Trump, I think they are now starting to realize, ‘Wait a minute, this is not popular. Trump is not popular.'”

item.title: Willie Colón, Trailblazing Salsa Musician, Dies at 75
item.description: “While we grieve his absence, we also rejoice in the timeless gift of his music and the cherished memories he created that will live on forever," his family shared in a statement.

item.title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Sweeps Annie Awards
item.description: The animation honors are presented by the L.A. branch of the International Animated Film Association.
